message:
Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, Structural Dynamicist, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor and Manager, added stiffness cannot do this job while pure damping addition can within dead load and look.

In plain words jacking frequency out of the walking band needs a lot of new steel while two small masses with damping absorb the same resonance, and the precedent of 37 viscous plus 52 tuned-mass units keeping the silhouette by working under deck stated in the Millennium Bridge, London (E39) means an under-deck clamped solution is buildable without deck change. Raising 1.9 Hz to 2.3 Hz needs 46.5 percent more stiffness from the stiffness-increase calculation (E27), added Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), weight 7.85 kN from the static-weight calculation (E26) is 1.31 percent from the weight-fraction calculation (E72) of 600 kN live load from the live-load estimate (E30), and with about 230 kg beam plus bracket steel at 2.26 kN the total is 1.69 percent from the total-weight calculation (E76) inside the 2 percent rule, about two people against a crowded deck.

Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, the no-weld friction joint holds steady weight plus crowd dynamics plus a stop hit without fatigue-critical welds.

In plain words preload friction does the holding and the bracket must still hold when the mass hits the stops, and the rule that the damper can be bolted in the most effective location stated in the Retrofitting Eagles Meadow Bridge with a Tuned Mass Damper (E46) supports a bolted midspan clamp over welding. Slip resistance 32.9 kN per bolt from the slip-resistance calculation (E64) exceeds 13.1 kN combined demand from the combined-load calculation (E65) which already includes 8.40 kN stop hit from the stop-force calculation (E66), about 16 body weights against about 42 body weights capacity per bolt, so margin holds.

Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, I name our joint mounting interface in order from the device ends into the host, viewed between the girders below the soffit at midspan looking along the bridge, as central twin-mass zone to spring-plus-damper zone to single short transverse cross-beam zone to left beam-end-to-girder-web clamp zone and right beam-end-to-girder-web clamp zone to left girder host zone and right girder host zone, transverse perpendicular not longitudinal, all below the soffit within girder depth with nothing above deck, and I require any clamp callout to land only in those two beam-to-web clamp zones with High-Strength Friction-Grip, defined as High-Strength Friction-Grip (HSFG), bolts only there, jointly confirmed by Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead before any ready vote.

I am ready, because dead load with beam steel stays inside 2 percent, slip holds with stop load fed back, and the zone-ordered binding is jointly confirmed.
